prerequisites: No previous programming experience is required.

learning_outcomes.text: Introduce the elements and practicalities of computer programming through the MATLAB mathematical computing environment.
Gain a comprehensive understanding of the basic concepts of programming in Matlab and Simulink.
Provide comprehensive knowledge and skills for participants to build user-friendly interface using MATLAB.
Be able to use MATLAB and Simulink in their own work.
Be prepared to deepen their MATLAB programming skills.

syllabus_topics: MATLAB operations for computing with data
Writing, editing, running, and debugging M-Files
Distinction between script and function M-files
Basic programming structures and best practices
Building graphical user interfaces (GUIs) in MATLAB with application of GUIDE
User interface controls (push buttons, text boxes)
Discrete and continuous system modeling in Simulink
Introduction to finite element analysis using Pde Toolbox
assessment_rules: There is no exam during the lectures. Only active participation in the lectures and passing test will be required.
bibliography: Gilat A.: Matlab. An Introduction with applications. John Wiley & Son, 2005.
Marchand P., Holland O.T.: Grapfics and GUIs with Matlab. Chapman &Hall/CRC, 2003.
